title: Savings Plans: Compute vs EC2 Instance

kcs.statement: A Savings Plan commits to a fixed spend in dollars per hour for 1 or 3 years; usage up to the commitment gets the discounted rate and usage above it is billed at On-Demand rates.
Compute Savings Plans (up to 66% off) apply automatically across EC2 instance families, sizes, Regions and operating systems, and also to Fargate and Lambda usage.
EC2 Instance Savings Plans (up to 72% off) lock the discount to one instance family in one Region, trading flexibility for a deeper saving similar to a Standard RI.
